objective: Expand native pixel-shift aggregation to the Nikon models confirmed below; no other NX Studio features.
evidence_boundaries: An official shooting feature does not establish native merger compatibility.
Ordinary NEF layout and LibRaw decode evidence do not validate a pixel-shift sequence.
Authored fixtures do not establish authentic sensor movement or NX Studio sample parity.
Every model remains experimental until authentic capture/reference and downstream application acceptance.

official_merge_contract.note: The shared NX Studio table defines nine merge modes. Camera manuals confirm the shooting feature; per-camera authentic sequences are still required.

models.name: Nikon Z8
models.evidence: Existing synthetic vendor-output replays and native nine-mode tests; see pixel-shift-native-modes.json.

ordinary_source.note: Catalog says 8bit; the original TIFF and LibRaw establish 14-bit lossless compression code 3.

new_model_observations.layout: Classic little-endian TIFF; six SubIFDs; single-strip 14-bit RGGB Nikon Bayer RAW at index 1.
new_model_observations.decode: All three decode at full raw geometry with matching crop, equal black levels, equal green gains and white level 16383.

run.revision_note: Probe was new and uncommitted at this base revision; its exact bytes are identified by probe_sha256.
run.diagnostic: tifffile logs missing image-offset/byte-count tags while inspecting metadata-only nested IFDs; all three RAW images decoded successfully.

new_model_observations.limits: Sequential source decoding; 60 second external timeout; no full-resolution synthesis or vendor run.

color_matrix_followup.observation: The original Z5II source decodes but returns an all-zero 3x3 XYZ-to-camera matrix. The LibRaw table contains Zf and Z6III entries but no Z5II entry. Zf and Z6III originals return nonsingular matrices.
color_matrix_followup.runtime_contract: Only the observed all-zero Z5II matrix can be absent. Preserve source color tags and return metadata null plus an explicit merge-report limitation. Nonfinite or nonzero singular matrices still fail; other models retain the matrix requirement. No rendering matrix is invented.
color_matrix_followup.revision_note: Probe adds the matrix field on top of this base; exact probe bytes are pinned by SHA-256.

official_sources.finding: C firmware 3.00 adds AE bracketing under Pixel shift shooting > Options.
Options includes AE bracketing with exposure count and increment.

ae_bracketing.user_requested_scope: Process each exposure as its own native pixel-shift sequence, then publish all NEFX outputs together. HDR fusion remains downstream.
ae_bracketing.interface: --ae-bracketing N --output-directory DIR; N is an explicit 2-9 exposure count, --outputs applies per exposure.
ae_bracketing.grouping_contract: Contiguous complete sequences with equal capture modes, strict within-sequence metadata, common camera/geometry, distinct exposure settings and consecutive absolute shutter counts across the supplied batch. Per-exposure shot numbers may reset. No undocumented Nikon AE-program tag is interpreted.

ci.result: All seven jobs passed: Linux x86_64/ARM64, macOS ARM64, Windows x86_64, ASan/UBSan, changed-file checks and npm package assembly/smoke. Native jobs include all AE regressions and standalone package checks.

ae_bracketing.evidence_kind: Synthetic small packed14 fixtures, saved pre-C++ sample expectations, actual LibRaw readback, and separately recorded metamorphic batch-isolation probes.

verification.result: Both presets pass 4 CTests, 128 core cases, 32 format cases, 36 regular CLI cases and 38 AE cases; AE checks also cover 16 invalid inputs and 11 injected lifecycle failures.
verification.ae_modes: Z8/Z6III x nine modes x jobs/correction pairs (1/off, 2/on); separate 2- and 9-exposure bounds. All modes use existing independent saved expectations.
verification.independent_review: Standards and Spec approve. Spec reviewer ran 18 CLI commands with varying ISO, WB, sparse selection, nonzero radial coefficients and centers; 15 batch outputs match separate merges in decoded samples and normalized TIFF trees. Negative controls confirm sensitivity.
verification.limits: Small synthetic fixtures; each AE verification subprocess has a 45-second timeout and each aggregate ci.py runner a 300-second timeout. No full-resolution or vendor run.

Matching NX Studio NEFX references per exposure

automatic_ae_grouping.supersedes: The required explicit-count interface in the preceding ae_bracketing checkpoint. Its historical verification remains unchanged.
automatic_ae_grouping.interface: Exposure sequences are detected by default; --ae-bracketing N optionally requires 2-9 exposures. The C++ API uses brackets=0 for automatic grouping and brackets=1 to require one sequence.
automatic_ae_grouping.grouping_contract: Nikon 0x005e capture mode establishes each sequence length before total input count is interpreted. All complete blocks then pass existing sequence and cross-exposure identity, geometry, exposure and shutter-order validation. Multiple groups require a directory before decoding or publication.
automatic_ae_grouping.report_contract: ae_bracketing.exposure_count records the detected count; grouping is metadata_contiguous_sequences by default, explicit_count_contiguous_sequences with an expected count.
automatic_ae_grouping.completeness_boundary: Complete supplied exposure sequences do not establish the original camera AE-program count or identity. Missing entire leading or trailing exposures require an expected count to detect; internal shutter gaps still reject automatically.

source_metadata_observation.tool: ExifTool 13.59, read-only; product runtime uses the native metadata parser.
source_metadata_observation.observation: PixelShiftActive=Yes and PixelShiftNumberShots=32 coexist with BracketSet=AE/Flash and BracketProgram=Disabled in this authentic single-exposure capture. A bracket menu type alone does not identify active AE.
source_metadata_observation.limit: This is not an AE bracket capture and does not validate AE-program fields in pixel-shift AE mode.

coverage_limits: This is the four-model set confirmed from official manuals, not a promise to cover future firmware or every Nikon model.

Z9, Z6II, Z5, Zfc, Z50II and ZR manual indexes did not expose a pixel-shift shooting entry in this bounded check; they are not allowlisted. Z7II manual URL returned 404, so no negative support claim is inferred.
HE/HE*, HLG, non-FX image areas and unobserved metadata versions remain unsupported or unvalidated as documented in project-scope.json.
